style: soft 3D cartoon, top-down, warm and friendly
themeWhy: pale sandy stones and golden-tan buttons: kraft (tan) keys in the objects' own warm family, a magenta-marker Enter as the joyful contrasting treat, never red or violet.

images.why: Look: 'A track of stepping stones with a jump arc over every pair of neighbours'; Stage: 'Stepping stones run across the working area: ten stones, each 96 across'. One blank stone reused for every number stone, the zero stone and the small letter stones; every digit, letter and the arcs are drawn in code over it.
images.prompt: One single flat river stone seen from above, a smooth rounded oval pebble of pale warm sandy grey-beige with a fine natural grain, a few small darker mineral flecks, a matte slightly rough stone surface and a thick rounded edge. Plain and blank on top.

images.why: Control 'Pairing tray: sets counters out two by two and stands any leftover on its own'; Wrong lines: 'without looking at the button left over'. One button reused for every counter in the heap, the pairs and the leftover.
images.prompt: One single round wooden button seen from above, golden-tan, with a smooth glossy top, a raised rounded rim and four small round thread holes in the middle.

images.why: Phase 3 question 2: 'Pair the 14 socks: is 14 even or odd?'. One sock reused for every counter in the heap, the pairs and the leftover; a button there would contradict the name.
images.prompt: One single small child's sock lying flat, seen from above, soft plain knitted cotton in warm butter-cream, with a snug rounded cuff, a rounded heel and a rounded toe. Plain and one colour, nothing on its surface.
